subject: Adoption Accelerator: temporary entry-rate concession ask — VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Adoption Accelerator concession ask for PulseGrid pilot

Hi Jordan / Ben (cc Marissa),

Quick background: PulseGrid Labs (pilot running with their R&D team) has asked for a lower entry price to accelerate adoption across three internal teams. The pilot is strong on technical fit but the executive sponsor is price-sensitive — they need a firmer onboarding number to commit to a 12-month expansion plan. Current committed MRR in our model is low (~$8k) but the forecasted expansion to production, if the pilot converts, is material (~$150k ARR in year 1).

What I'm requesting: a one-time, entry-rate concession (we'd apply as a credit against the first two invoices) capped at $40,000. The commercial ask is: reduce listed onboarding fees and give a 50% introductory service credit for the first 60 days. We propose a mandatory 12-month minimum commitment (MRR floor $25k) with a true-up if they fall short — this mitigates revenue risk.

Rationale: this is a high-signal strategic account in the Midwest health-tech vertical; marketing is willing to co-invest if we can close in Q3. We can use the concession to secure a faster signature window and a joint case study.

Attachments: pulsegrid-mop-forecast.xlsx, ma-snapshot.pdf (both attached).

Ask: Jordan/Marissa — can we get VP/CFO conditional signoff for up to $40k as a one-time concession structured as credit + 12-month committed minimum? If yes, I'll prepare an amendment for legal and route DocuSign.

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0134
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Adoption Accelerator concession ask for PulseGrid pilot

Tessa — thanks for the summary. A few clarifying points before I escalate: 

- What's the expected ARR if they convert and hit the expansion plan vs. our baseline? You flagged ~150k ARR year 1 — is that net new?
- Is the $40k concession refundable or credited (i.e., does it impact cash collection timeline)?
- Who owns the marketing co-invest (amt/$) and is that contingent on case study approval?
- Any existing negotiated terms (termination, onboarding timing) we should be aware of?

If we can show a clear 12–18 month payback on the concession and legal can get the amendment in place quickly, I can push for VP clearance. Ben — any commercial framework you'd like to propose (staged credit, performance milestone tranche)?

-Jordan

Short note with a suggested structure: we should avoid a straight cash concession. Instead propose: 

1) One-time onboarding credit: $35,000 applied as credit over their first two invoices (month 1 = $20k credit, month 2 = $15k credit).
2) 12-month committed MRR floor of $25k (if they fall below, they pay the difference pro rata in month 12).
3) Performance milestone: if they hit 3 internal team rollouts within 6 months, we convert credit to a marketing co-funded case study and provide an additional $5k professional services credit.
4) Always subject to legal amendment and finance approval for recognition/timelines.

This reduces cash exposure to $35k (vs $40k asked) and ties upside to adoption. I've attached a brief term schedule (commercial-term-schedule.docx) with a few permutations: credit-only, credit+true-up, credit+revenue-share.

Ben

Appreciate the clear ask and the proposed mitigations. Conditional CFO signoff provided under the following terms: 

1) Concession capped at $35,000 (apply as credits to the first two invoices).
2) Signed amendment with a minimum 12-month committed MRR floor of $25,000; legal to include a true-up clause if minimum is not met.
3) Finance to agree recognition schedule (credits will be recorded as deferred revenue release over the 3rd–12th months to avoid one-time GAAP impact).
4) Marketing co-invest contingent on an approved joint-publication plan.

This approval is conditional on legal and finance confirmation. Please route the amendment to Legal (contracts@redwood.com) and copy FP&A (finance@redwood.com) for tracking and for me to sign off on the final DocuSign packet.
